studies.label: trypsin-benzamidine free ligand binding, 495 x 100 ns unbiased MD + MSM

system.value: bovine β-trypsin with the inhibitor benzamidine placed in bulk (free ligand binding)

ensemble.where: Materials and Methods / Free-Binding Production Simulations

timestep.where: Materials and Methods / Free-Binding Production Simulations

minimization.value: minimized with heavy protein atoms restrained by a 10 kcal mol-1 Å-2 spring

equilibration_restraints.value: heavy protein atoms restrained at 10, then 1, then 0.05 kcal mol-1 Å-2; Cα atoms restrained at 1 kcal mol-1 Å-2 during the 10 ns NPT relaxation

production.where: Materials and Methods / Free-Binding Production Simulations

replicas.where: Materials and Methods / Free-Binding Production Simulations

method_details.value: Free ligand binding by unbiased MD with hydrogen mass repartitioning: 500 starting conformations sampled from a 50 ns preproduction run with the ligand kept at least 20 Å from the protein and diffusing in the xy plane only; harmonic restraint (1 kcal mol-1 Å-2) on Cα atoms farther than 9 Å from the pocket; flat-bottomed restraint (0.1 kcal mol-1 Å-2, box (30,30,80)) on benzamidine C7 around the pocket; analysed with Markov state models on the C7 position (2D 2,500-state MSM, lag 50 ns; 5-state model; 3D 9,700-state MSM)
method_details.where: Materials and Methods / Free-Binding Production Simulations
